written_for: b11.5 T2, the corner mark exemption beside an enlarged initial
reuse: None. Every site below was located in the current tree by matching its anchor text, and this record fails to build if one has moved.

absolute_item.statement: A composition carrying pdf_form or pdf_curve is never reclassified. Absolute, and not softened by any finding.
absolute_item.structural_note: create_composition builds a formula from characters alone, so a composition made by this predicate holds no graphic at the moment it is made; graphics are assigned to formulas afterwards by collect_contained_elements. The count above is taken after the whole stage has run, so it covers that assignment too.

sites.reads: the pdf_form list held inside a formula composition
sites.effect: This and the curve site below are the only render entry for graphics carried inside a formula; a reclassified composition would drop them silently, because PdfLine has neither member. Measured: no reclassified composition carries a form or a curve, and the page level form and curve counts are identical in both arms on every page of every sample, so nothing is dropped and nothing is orphaned.

sites.reads: the pdf_curve list held inside a formula composition
sites.effect: As above; the two sites are one question and are counted together.

sites.reads: a formula's characters, when flattening a paragraph for render
sites.effect: The characters are the same objects either way; the sibling branch for a line reaches them by the same extend. Nothing renders differently on this account.

sites.reads: the corner mark flag, to decide whether a formula is translatable
sites.effect: This is the one place downstream of the predicate that reads the flag itself. It converts a non corner mark formula of digits back into a line. A composition the exemption keeps out of formula never reaches it, which is the same outcome by a shorter road.
sites.verdict: unreachable for the exempted span, by construction

sites.reads: every formula of a page, to assign page curves and forms to them
sites.effect: A formula that no longer exists is not offered as a home for a curve, so the curve stays on the page and is drawn from there. Measured over the full stage rather than the formula pass alone: page level counts move on no page.

sites.reads: a formula composition, to make one typesetting unit of it
sites.effect: A formula becomes a unit the typesetter carries whole and does not scale with the text. Reclassified, its characters join the text unit beside them and are set with it. That is the repair: the letters of an opening word are set as the word they belong to.

sites.reads: whether a paragraph is nothing but formulas and whitespace, to skip translating it
sites.effect: A paragraph that was formula only could become text only and so be translated where it was not. Neither reclassified instance is in such a paragraph: both sit among text compositions of the same paragraph, so the paragraph was translated before and is translated now.
sites.verdict: no change on the measured instances

sites.reads: a formula composition, as an allowed member of a placeholder paragraph
sites.effect: The reading half of the site above; same answer.
sites.verdict: no change on the measured instances

sites.reads: a formula, to build its placeholder in the translate input
sites.effect: The non LLM translator, which CLAUDE.md section 2 forbids this project from using or altering. Recorded so the inventory is complete; the run path is ILTranslatorLLMOnly.

sites.reads: a formula's box, to draw it in the debug overlay
sites.effect: One fewer box is drawn in the debug document where a composition is reclassified. The debug overlay is not a product and no assertion reads it.

sites.reads: a formula's characters when composing a paragraph
sites.effect: Runs before the styling stage, so it never sees a composition this predicate touched. Listed because it reads the annotation.

sites.reads: a formula's characters, to adjust descent
sites.effect: Reaches the same characters through the line branch instead.

sites.reads: a formula's characters and box, for width, height and order
sites.effect: Every one of this file's formula branches has a line branch beside it reaching the same characters and the same box. The measured instances hold no graphics, so the box is the characters' own union either way.

sites.reads: the composition kind, to decide what may be regrouped by line
sites.effect: A formula is atomic and a line is splittable, so a reclassified composition becomes eligible for line regrouping. That is what lets the drop cap merge act at all, since its mergeable set is this splittable set.

sites.reads: the kind of the composition after the initial
sites.effect: The guard that refused to fold the initial into a formula. With the tail reclassified as a line the guard passes and the initial is merged, which is the whole chain this task is for. The guard itself is untouched: a formula tail still refuses.

sites.reads: whether a paragraph holds a formula, to decide if reflow may move it
sites.effect: A paragraph pinned because it held a formula may become movable. This is the one site where the reclassification could change a decision about a paragraph rather than about a composition, so the run's column_reflow report is compared against the baseline rather than reasoned about.

sites.reads: the composition kinds of a paragraph, to decide if it may be stitched
sites.effect: A paragraph holding a formula is disqualified from stitching. Reclassified, it may qualify. Both measured instances are single paragraphs that were already whole, so nothing is joined to them; the run's fragment_stitch report is compared against the baseline.

sites.reads: the composition kind, to mark a segment as one it may cut
sites.effect: A reclassified composition becomes cuttable by the bracket dedup pass. It only cuts where it finds a duplicated bracketed run, and neither measured instance holds a bracket.
sites.verdict: no change on the measured instances

sites.reads: every composition kind, to audit what the source held
sites.effect: Counts both kinds, so a composition moving between them changes which tally it lands in and not whether it is seen.

sites.reads: a formula's characters, when reading a paragraph's text for chaining
sites.effect: Reaches the same characters through the line branch instead.

sites.reads: all three character holders, when writing a repair back
sites.effect: Both kinds are in the tuple, so the holder is found either way.

sites.reads: all three character holders, when reading document order
sites.effect: As above.
